_comment: Commits per calendar month across the Bygmedai organisation, default branches only, measured by scripts/fetch-metrics.mjs on the same run as metrics.json and drawn on /workshop by scripts/build-monthly.mjs. A completed month is re-measured on every run and must come back the same; fetch-metrics refuses to publish if it does not. The first seven points are the hand measurement of 18 August 2026 that the chart was drawn from.
